arabic_html:
ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌۭ قَالُوٓا۟
إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ ۞
translation: When disaster strikes them, they say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.'
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: those struck by loss say this to steady themselves — remembering they belong to Allah, and to Him they return. It is the believer's response to every calamity.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: those struck by loss say this to steady themselves — remembering they belong to Allah, and to Him they return. It is the believer's response to every calamity.
